entries.title: Proverbs 11:1
segments: ¶Scales of deceit are hated by the Lord, but a true weight is his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:2
segments: ¶When pride comes, there comes shame, but wisdom is with the quiet in spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:3
segments: ¶The righteousness of the upright will be their guide, but the twisted ways of the false will be their destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:4
segments: ¶Wealth is of no profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness keeps a man safe from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:5
segments: ¶The righteousness of the good man will make his way straight, but the sin of the evil-doer will be the cause of his fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:6
segments: The righteousness of the upright will be their salvation, but the false will themselves be taken in their evil designs.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:7
segments: ¶At the death of an upright man his hope does not come to an end, but the hope of the evil-doer comes to destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:8
segments: ¶The upright man is taken out of trouble, and in his place comes the sinner.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:9
segments: ¶With his mouth the evil man sends destruction on his neighbour; but through knowledge the upright are taken out of trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:10
segments: ¶When things go well for the upright man, all the town is glad; at the death of sinners, there are cries of joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:11
segments: By the blessing of the upright man the town is made great, but it is overturned by the mouth of the evil-doer.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:12
segments: ¶He who has a poor opinion of his neighbour has no sense, but a wise man keeps quiet.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:13
segments: He who goes about talking of others makes secrets public, but the true-hearted man keeps things covered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:14
segments: ¶When there is no helping suggestion the people will have a fall, but with a number of wise guides they will be safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:15
segments: ¶He who makes himself responsible for a strange man will undergo much loss; but the hater of such undertakings will be safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:16
segments: ¶A woman who is full of grace is honoured, but a woman hating righteousness is a seat of shame: those hating work will undergo loss, but the strong keep their wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:17
segments: ¶The man who has mercy will be rewarded, but the cruel man is the cause of trouble to himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:18
segments: ¶The sinner gets the payment of deceit; but his reward is certain who puts in the seed of righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:19
segments: ¶So righteousness gives life; but he who goes after evil gets death for himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:20
segments: ¶The uncontrolled are hated by the Lord, but those whose ways are without error are his delight

entries.title: Proverbs 11:21
segments: ¶Certainly the evil-doer will not go free from punishment, but the seed of the upright man will be safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:22
segments: ¶Like a ring of gold in the nose of a pig, is a beautiful woman who has no sense.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:23
segments: ¶The desire of the upright man is only for good, but wrath is waiting for the evil-doer.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:24
segments: ¶A man may give freely, and still his wealth will be increased; and another may keep back more than is right, but only comes to be in need.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:25
segments: ¶He who gives blessing will be made fat, but the curser will himself be cursed.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:26
segments: ¶He who keeps back grain will be cursed by the people; but a blessing will be on the head of him who lets them have it for a price.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:27
segments: ¶He who, with all his heart, goes after what is good is searching for grace; but he who is looking for trouble will get it.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:28
segments: ¶He who puts his faith in wealth will come to nothing; but the upright man will be full of growth like the green leaf.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:29
segments: ¶The troubler of his house will have the wind for his heritage, and the foolish will be servant to the wise-hearted.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:30
segments: ¶The fruit of righteousness is a tree of life, but violent behaviour takes away souls.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:31
segments: ¶If the upright man is rewarded on earth, how much more the evil-doer and the sinner!
